_comment: C0-14 pika bodies EN. 无附加小节。正文「相关条目」3 行带 .md 链接（pixverse/runway/jimeng），related 写 3 条。sources 3 条对齐 frontmatter。

axes.model_access: In-house model line (official-site narrative); users do not pick bare models. An open-weights line — no official statement verified.
axes.runtime: Web (pika.art); generation on the vendor's cloud. There was once a Discord entry line (community-history narrative; current status not verified item by item).
axes.local_files: Works stored account-side in the cloud, generation history visible on the web works page; downloads go local. No officially stated local data surface.
axes.background: Generation is instant/queued (varies by tier, not verified item by item); no "keep-running-after-shutdown" task surface (no claim verified).
axes.tools: Text-to-video, image-to-video, **the Pikaffects effects line** (the physics-effect play named on the official site: balloon-pop/squash and other exaggerated effects, as seen in site navigation); stylization and editing lines (seen on the official site, details not verified item by item).
axes.context: Organized via the account works page (generation history reviewable); cross-session memory — no official statement verified. Reusable effect templates are asset reuse, not product memory.
axes.permissions: Account + subscription system (D9: prices not collected); the training-use switch not verified line by line; commercial and watermark limits on free-tier output follow the terms (not verified line by line).
axes.fit: Fits: social-oriented short effects (Pikaffects-style play), creative experiments, light meme material. Does not fit: cinematic long takes, character-consistent narrative, mainland direct connection (measured 000).

runs:
This site has not completed measured runs. The coding-oriented test protocol is at [protocols/coding/_protocol.md](../../../protocols/coding/_protocol.md) (the coding task suite does not apply to creative products).

**Suggested measurements** (three, all pointing at things the official readable pages do not give):

- **The actual usability and commercial limits of each Pikaffects effect template**
- **The real boundary of the free tier's watermark and commercial terms**
- **How well image-to-video preserves an existing character image**
unknowns:
- The open-weights line (no official statement verified)
- The Discord entry's current status and work migration (unverified)
- The training-use switch (not verified line by line)
- Cross-session memory mechanism (no official statement verified)
related: Both effects-play oriented: PixVerse has a heavier template ecosystem and domestic direct access, Pika's effects line is more single-point.
Both overseas video benches: Runway leans professional film/TV workflows, Pika leans social play.
The domestic alternative for effects play: Jimeng's effects-play line + mainland direct connection works.
sources: Pika · official site (product and capability narrative)
